method: GFN2-xTB single point and analytic gradient; gas phase
selection: Every primary endpoint from72 parents, two methods and two replicas, plus all72 common warm starts. Invert the first4 warm starts for an interface symmetry diagnostic. No energy ranking or optimization.
primary: Paired GFN2 restrained-potential difference at the same frozen endpoints as the eSEN primary result, averaging algorithm replicas within parent before bootstrap.
failure_rule: Keep every failed SCC/timeout/gradient result. Full primary energy comparison is unavailable if any required endpoint or inversion check fails. Success-only diagnostics are secondary and must retain their denominators.
scope: Independent approximate-potential consistency check; GFN2 is not the sampled eSEN target and SCC convergence is not quantum chemical validity or a Boltzmann certificate.
